card.name: Verbs before blood pressure or circulation
card.fires_on: A verb or linking word right before a circulation term such as blood, blood pressure, circulation or oxygen delivery. It appears in heart and blood pressure drug-label text.

modes.label: Verb before blood
modes.description: An action verb about the heart or body that is followed by blood or blood pressure.
modes.example: which<< pumps>> blood to the lungs.

modes.label: Support of circulation
modes.description: The word supporting or support of just before circulatory function in heart failure warnings.
modes.example: Sympathetic stimulation is a vital component<< supporting>> circulatory function in congestive heart failure

modes.label: Linking word before a body part
modes.description: A short link word or verb that leads into a circulation-related object.
modes.example: because of aortocaval compression<< by>> the gravid uterus.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for circulation-related objects such as blood, pressure or flow next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before blood, blood pressure or circulation is named.
